up: Find all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5260813'. For each compound, retrieve its ChEMBL identifier, preferred name (if any), maximum clinical development phase, molecule type (e.g., small molecule, protein), and canonical SMILES. Return the results sorted by the compound's ChEMBL identifier in ascending order. List each unique compound only once.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5260813'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
